intro: Mines Saint-Étienne graduate. Three years at Safran on critical embedded defence systems (C, Linux, FPGA, secure networking), then backend-focused fullstack engineer (Rust) at Cureety.

platform.label: Oncology remote-monitoring SaaS platform
platform.description: Patients are followed daily through questionnaires tailored to their treatment. Grew from 10,000 to 50,000 monitored patients during my time, in a team of 15.
tasks: Led the full rewrite of the Node backend in Rust, a choice driven by my embedded background: from an overloaded service restarted every 30 minutes to a stable backend while load grew fivefold.
End-to-end tests of the Rust services, with external services simulated.
Deployment and operations of containerised services on AWS and GCP, Jenkins continuous integration.
Maintenance of the existing LoopbackJS backends.
Progressive migration of the React/NextJS interfaces to Flutter (Android, iOS, web), plus new features.

beluga.label: Embedded time & frequency system — Naval Group: maintenance, then redesign
beluga.description: Autonomous high-precision clock distributing time in many electrical and digital formats, in a constrained environment (dedicated electronics, FPGA, software). Multidisciplinary team of 2 to 5 (software, electronics, FPGA, mechanics, IVVQ).

tasks.label: Design of the new system
items: Embedded C/Linux software: scheduling, control of the FPGAs and dedicated boards, UART, TCP/IP over SSL, PostgreSQL.
V-cycle, MISRA C compliant code, SonarQube static analysis.
Python/Qt operator HMI (TCP/IP over SSL, PostgreSQL), screens and procedures designed with the end customer.
Design and code compliant with Naval Group cybersecurity requirements.
Full system simulator (Python/Qt) for test automation and operator training.
Software lead: wrote the technical documentation and defended design choices in reviews with Naval Group experts.
Technical documentation and reports generated automatically (Typst).

tasks.label: Maintenance of the legacy system, untouched for years
items: Took over a C/Linux computer with no documentation and no remaining expertise: code audit and reverse engineering of its behaviour.
Bug fixing of the computer's software.
Simulation engine for the electronic and FPGA environment (Python/Qt, UART) to test and validate every software release without the target hardware.

navkite.label: Resilient navigation unit (NavKite)
navkite.description: Inertial navigation unit coupled with a GNSS receiver that detects malicious signals: from prototype to a Safran Electronics & Defense catalogue product.
tasks: Python backend: acquisition and control of the inertial unit, protection against malicious signals, API for the web interface.
Proof of concept within weeks, then continuous improvement and field demonstrations.
Industrialisation: packaging and custom Linux OS (Buildroot).

chaperon.label: GNSS simulation for a defence application (Skydel)
chaperon.description: Drone spoofing prototype broadcasting modified GNSS signals.
tasks: Adapted a civil simulator to critical defence use (C++17, Qt, encryption).
C++ backend supervising and controlling the whole system (simulator, hardware), exposed as an API.
Integration with other systems and customer demonstrations.

artcard.label: Atomic reference time card (ARTCARD)
artcard.description: Open-source card co-developed with Meta for datacenters: FPGA, u-blox GNSS receiver, MRO50 miniature atomic clock.
tasks: Clock disciplining on GNSS in C, open-source development and support (github.com/Orolia2s/oscillatord).
Contribution to the open-source Linux driver, since merged into the kernel (github.com/Time-Appliances-Project/Time-Card); internal fork for prototypes.
Programming (FTDI, FPGA, EEPROM) and test bench, with an operator HMI for production at the EMS AsteelFlash.
